title: SYNTHESIZRR: Generating Diverse Datasets with Retrieval Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring entity entropy, entity recall, and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of entity distributions using named entity recognition to determine if the generative model over-represents popular 'head' entities compared to long-tail entities.

Evaluating downstream classification accuracy on the HYPERPARTISAN dataset to measure how well distilled student models can detect hyperpartisan and politically biased language in simulated news articles.
